tasks.title: Lecture #9
tasks.instruction: Listen to part of a radio program about nature.
tasks.transcript: The camel is an example of an animal that is especially adapted to survive in harsh conditions. First of all，camels have humps on their backs. Now many people think that camels hold water in their humps. But that is actually not true. While camels do have to store water, what they carry in their humps is not water but fat. That’s their emergency supply of energy in case there’s little food to eat. Of course camels wouldn’t need to carry a safety supply of fat if it were easy to find something to eat where they live. Unfortunately in a desert, camels can sometimes walk for days in the hot sun looking for food and water. So when there is little to eat，the fat from their hump allows them to survive for quite a long time, even up to two weeks without eating anything. When they do get an opportunity to eat and drink, camels consume as much as possible. A camel can drink incredible amounts of water，a lot more than most other animals can take in without getting sick. You see, there’s a limit on how much an animal can drink. If an animal were to drink more than necessary, that could even be bad for that animal’s health. But a camel’s body does not suffer the effects of too much water. After it has stored up plenty of food and water, it can go on for days in a hot desert.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.A: Places where camels look for food in the desert
options.B: How camels survive in the desert
options.C: New kinds of foods discovered in the desert
options.D: Why temperatures change quickly in the desert

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：这次谈话的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：The camel is an example of an animal that is especially adapted to survive in harsh conditions. 选项分析： A. 骆驼在沙漠中寻找食物的地方。谈话并未具体讨论骆驼寻找食物的地点，而是整体介绍其生存机制，因此A选项错误。 B. 骆驼如何在沙漠中生存。开篇即点明骆驼是适应恶劣环境生存的典范，后续内容围绕其驼峰功能、饮水能力等适应特征展开，因此B选项正确。 C. 在沙漠中发现的新型食物。谈话完全没有提及任何新发现的食物类型，因此C选项错误。 D. 为什么沙漠中温度变化快。谈话内容与沙漠温度变化无关，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What false belief about camels does the speaker correct?

options.B: That they are found only in hot regions
options.C: That they can easily find water in the desert
options.D: That they store water in their humps

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：关于骆驼的哪种错误观点被演讲者纠正了？ 定位原文：Now many people think that camels hold water in their humps. But that is actually not true. While camels do have to store water, what they carry in their humps is not water but fat. 选项分析： A. 它们跑得非常快。谈话中完全没有提及骆驼的奔跑速度，因此A选项错误。 B. 它们只出现在炎热地区。谈话虽然以沙漠环境为例，但并未讨论骆驼的地理分布范围，因此B选项错误。 C. 它们在沙漠中可以轻易找到水。谈话指出骆驼有时要走很远寻找食物和水，暗示并不容易，但并未直接将其作为一个普遍的“错误观点”来纠正，因此C选项错误。 D. 它们把水储存在驼峰里。演讲者明确指出这是许多人的误解，并纠正说驼峰里储存的是脂肪，因此D选项正确。

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply about the food that camels eat?

options.D: It contains a lot of water.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：关于骆驼吃的食物，演讲者暗示了什么？ 定位原文：That's their emergency supply of energy in case there's little food to eat. ... Unfortunately in a desert, camels can sometimes walk for days in the hot sun looking for food and water. 选项分析： A. 它富含脂肪。食物本身是否富含脂肪并未提及，脂肪是储存在骆驼驼峰里的，因此A选项错误。 B. 它干得很快。谈话并未讨论食物的干燥速度，因此B选项错误。 C. 它很难找到。由于沙漠中食物稀少，骆驼有时要走好几天去寻找，这暗示了食物很难找到，因此C选项正确。 D. 它含有大量水分。谈话提到骆驼能大量饮水，但并未说明食物本身含水量高，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker，what is harmful to most animals’ health?

options.B: Eating food that is very old
options.D: Spending a lot of time in the sun

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：根据演讲者的说法，什么对大多数动物的健康有害？ 定位原文：If an animal were to drink more than necessary, that could even be bad for that animal's health. 选项分析： A. 喝太多水。原文明确指出，如果动物喝水超过必要量，可能对健康有害，因此A选项正确。 B. 吃非常旧的食物。谈话完全没有提及食物变质与动物健康的关系，因此B选项错误。 C. 长时间不休息。谈话讨论了骆驼可以长时间不进食，但并未将缺乏休息作为对大多数动物有害的因素，因此C选项错误。 D. 长时间待在阳光下。谈话提到骆驼在烈日下行走，但并未说明晒太阳本身对大多数动物有害，因此D选项错误。
